## Title

CHATBOT is not AGENT

## Caption (Instagram)

```
A chatbot answers. An agent answers and then takes steps: it plans, uses a tool, checks the result. The difference is not magic, it is wiring. Which is why the actions that matter need permissions and a human.
```

Length: 209 characters.

## YouTube Shorts

**Title:** Chatbot or agent?

**Description:**

```
A chatbot answers. An agent answers and then takes steps: it plans, uses a tool, checks the result. The difference is not magic, it is wiring. Which is why the actions that matter need permissions and a human.

Sources:
- A chatbot answers a question; it does not run a workflow. (A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)) https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/ checked 2026-10-29
- An agent is a model given tools it can call. (Building effective agents (Anthropic)) https://www.anthropic.com/research/building-effective-agents checked 2026-10-29
- Tools let an agent take actions such as preparing an invitation or sending a message. (A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)) https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/ checked 2026-10-29
- The difference between a chatbot and an agent is how the system is wired, not how intelligent the model is. (Building effective agents (Anthropic)) https://www.anthropic.com/research/building-effective-agents checked 2026-10-29
- An agent works in a loop: plan, use a tool, check the result, continue. (A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)) https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/ checked 2026-10-29
- Agents can take unintended actions, which is why guardrails are added from real failures. (A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)) https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/ checked 2026-10-29
- Sensitive or irreversible actions should stop for human oversight and approval. (A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)) https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/ checked 2026-10-29
- An agent picks its tools as the work changes, always inside defined guardrails. (A practical guide to building agents (OpenAI)) https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/ checked 2026-10-29
```
